# Still decode fixtures

Tiny self-generated 64x48 solid-color fixtures used by the local/native still
decode tests (`test/data/media/native/native_still_decoder_live_test.dart`).

- `sample.heic` — HEIC, 64x48, solid color
- `sample.avif` — AVIF, 64x48, solid color

Generated locally; no third-party content.
